data.name: Ashish Biradar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ashish Biradar has made a big mark in cricket. With 23 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 50, with an average of 12.17 and a quick strike rate of 106.83. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 16 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 17.2 overs, taking 6 wickets at an economy rate of 11.54. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
